sharedRules.name: KYRON'S HUNT (2)
sharedRules.description:
This is a Group Action that may be used any number of times in a Round.

Spend the Power to nominate a group and activate them together. The members of the group each make a Run action and gain the Pathfinder special rule for the duration of this action. The group members must finish their movement within 3” of each other and models may not Engage any enemy models with their movement.

sharedRules.name: Spell - Kyron’s Curse
sharedRules.description: Instead of causing damage, for each hit scored, the target’s Sp is reduced by 2 (to a minimum of 0) until the end of the Round.

sharedRules.name: Spell - Stampede
sharedRules.description:
Target a friendly model that has not already been activated this Round. The caster rolls no dice. Instead, the target must take a Nerve test with a +1 modifier. If the test is failed, the model is marked as Fatigued. If the test is passed, the target model must immediately Run and must Engage the closest enemy model . If an enemy model cannot be Engaged, move the target model as far as possible. If the target is Engaged with a qualifying Charge
action, resolve the Melee attack by the charging model as normal. Once the attack and any Retaliation are resolved, mark the target model as Fatigued, but not Activated.

sharedRules.name: Weapon - Two-handed Weapon
sharedRules.description: The model gains Crushing Strength (1), but increases its Armor by 1 (i.e 5+ becomes 6+).

sharedRules.name: NATURE'S BOON (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when taking a cast action. Nature’s Boon allows the model to cast a long action spell as a short action.

sharedRules.name: Tribal Hunter Shooting
sharedRules.description: When involved in a Group Shoot Action, Hunter models add +1 dice to their Ranged Attack roll if one or more other Hunter models in the group fire at the same target.

sharedRules.name: Vengeful Spirits
sharedRules.description: When this model is killed and removed from play, each enemy model it was Enganging or Engaged with must take a Nerve test. Any model that fails will suffer 1 wound with no armour save possible.

sharedRules.name: BATTLE RAGE (2)
sharedRules.description: If this model can Engage an enemy model with a follow-up move, it may spend the Power and Engage that model and initiate another Melee by using the ability to go into a Battle Rage. This model will not get any bonus dice for charging however. Once this second Melee has been resolved, mark this model as Fatigued.
